tool_input.description: Compile and run scratch program to observe actual output

result:
Only the intended test file was created (the rest are pre-existing/unrelated environment files); no scratch files remain.

Created `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/builder/MultilineRecursiveToStringStyleAgentTest.java` with 16 self-contained JUnit 5 tests covering: nested-object reflection formatting, all overridden primitive array types plus `Object[]` (including a 2D array and the raw-`Object` reflection path), empty/null arrays, null and primitive-wrapper/`String` fields that must *not* be recursed into, style-instance reuse not accumulating indentation, the empty-object case, and a `NullPointerException` boundary case when `appendDetail(Object)` is called directly with a `null` value. All tests pass via `./_tools/test.sh`.
